note: Small gravel RV park on US-26/85 just west of Torrington (renamed Easy Spot RV), between the highway and open fields; a busy rail line runs just across the highway. Sells weekly and monthly stays too. --Claude
summary: Renamed Frontier RV -> Easy Spot RV (same address); old domain dead -> easyspotrv.com; phone 308-641-1703 -> 307-401-3029. $30 daily ($150 wk, $525 mo), full hookups 30/50 A, pull-throughs, showers, online booking (ResNexus). Google: listing with no reviews yet. Long-stay leaning (night/month/'workers'), nightly share unmeasured. Pin on the highway ~160 m from the lot. Not waterfront stands.
